claim: Server and front end bundled into one binary or Docker container
Supports MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite; SQLite bundled; MySQL 5.7 unsupported
Install methods: binary, source, Docker, Debian/Ubuntu, RPM, Arch, Alpine, FreeBSD, Kubernetes, Ansible
Mobile app supports only very basic features
Default CORS needs service.publicurl or cors.enable false
Admin panel, audit logs and time tracking are in Vikunja Pro; hosted version Vikunja Cloud; LLM-assisted coding note
Documentation index lists OpenID, LDAP, webhooks, API and migration from third-party services
